<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series spaced ~1 Da apart with intensities following a binomial distribution (≈11 % for M+1, decreasing for higher peaks), the pattern matches the natural 13C/12C distribution. No characteristic Cl, Br, S, or other element patterns are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
